description: A content administrator gets past a rule of a class by the group alone, and that is an override (ADR-0052, item 4). A command by override needs a reason: without one it is refused with reason_required and the place of the first rule it would lift, and nothing is written. With one it is made, and its event keeps the rules lifted and the reason; the moves the engine makes after it are not marked. A command the rules let through is an ordinary one, and a reason given with it is ignored. A guard holds for a content administrator as for everyone.

script.name: a content administrator reads it, and no reason is asked for a read
to change it she needs a reason: the refusal names the first rule she would get past
a preview says the same and goes on
with a reason the change is made
a guard holds for her as for everyone
and sends the memo past the rule of the transition; the engine files it by itself
each of her commands is marked with the rules it lifted and its reason, and the engine's own move is not
her own memo is an ordinary document: the rules let her through
no reason is asked where no rule is lifted
and a reason given all the same is not kept
nobody deletes a memo, so her delete of her own is an override too
the events of her own memo carry no mark
